tasks.label: Build
tasks.command: compiler="$(command -v g++-14 || command -v g++)"; build_type="${input:buildType}"; build_target="${input:buildTarget}"; build_types=(debug release); build_targets=(cli uomul gui); if [[ "$build_type" != all ]]; then build_types=("$build_type"); fi; if [[ "$build_target" != all ]]; then build_targets=("$build_target"); fi; for type in "${build_types[@]}"; do for target in "${build_targets[@]}"; do preset="${type}-${target}"; cmake --preset "$preset" -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="$compiler" && cmake --build --preset "$preset" || exit $?; done; done

tasks.label: Run Benchmarks
tasks.command: compiler="$(command -v g++-14 || command -v g++)"; target="${input:benchmarkTarget}"; cmake --preset release-map-benchmarks -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="$compiler" || exit $?; targets=(map_benchmarks radarcol_benchmarks texmaps_benchmarks); if [[ "$target" != all ]]; then targets=("${target}_benchmarks"); fi; cmake --build --preset release-map-benchmarks --target "${targets[@]}" --parallel 2 || exit $?; for benchmark in "${targets[@]}"; do build/release-map-benchmarks/benchmarks/"$benchmark" --benchmark-samples 10 --benchmark-resamples 1000 --benchmark-warmup-time 0 || exit $?; done

tasks.label: Clean
tasks.command: build_type="${input:buildType}"; build_target="${input:buildTarget}"; build_types=(debug release); build_targets=(cli uomul gui); if [[ "$build_type" != all ]]; then build_types=("$build_type"); fi; if [[ "$build_target" != all ]]; then build_targets=("$build_target"); fi; for type in "${build_types[@]}"; do for target in "${build_targets[@]}"; do build_dir="build/${type}-${target}"; if [[ -d "$build_dir" ]]; then cmake -E rm -rf "$build_dir" || exit $?; fi; done; done

tasks.label: Test Debug GUI
tasks.command: cmake --preset debug-gui && cmake --build --preset debug-gui --target gui_tests uo-mule && ctest --preset debug-gui

tasks.label: Test Debug CLI
tasks.command: cmake --preset debug-cli && cmake --build --preset debug-cli --target cli_tests uo-mule && ctest --preset debug-cli

tasks.label: Test Debug uomul
tasks.command: cmake --preset debug-uomul && cmake --build --preset debug-uomul --target uomul_tests && ctest --preset debug-uomul
